pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal regions with moderately sharp edge gradients. Geometry transitions from rhomboidal on the upper neck to irregular trapezoidal forms on the mid-flank. Patch area is significantly larger than the separating light pathways.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored negative space forming a topological graph. Junction nodes are primarily tri-vertex intersections. Pathway thickness remains relatively uniform across the neck, approximately 10-15% of adjacent patch width.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: High-frequency, low-amplitude bristled silhouette visible on the upper neck. The contour presents as a series of fine, vertical pixel-clusters against the distal background.
